```{=html}
        display: flex;              
        justify-content: center;    
        align-items: center;

    .pick-image {
        width: 550px; 
        display: block; /* or flex, depending on your layout needs */
        position: relative;
        border-radius: 2%;
        line-height: 0; /* Removes any extra space below inline images */
        box-shadow: 5px 5px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    }
    .pick-image p {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        line-height: 0;
    }
    .pick-image img {
        display: block; /* Removes any extra space below the image */
        max-width: 100%; /* Ensures the image is not wider than its container */
        height: auto; /* Maintains the image's aspect ratio */
        border-radius: 2%;
    }
</style>
<script>
    function initializeDailyPhoto() {
        fetch('/picked-photo/photos.json')
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            const photos = data.photos;
            const today = new Date();
            const seed = today.getFullYear() * 1000 + (today.getMonth()) * 100 + today.getDate();
            
            // Simple pseudo-random number generator
            function seededRandom(seed) {
                let x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000;
                return x - Math.floor(x);
            }

            const randomIndex = Math.floor(seededRandom(seed) * photos.length);
            const photo = photos[randomIndex];
            
            const photoElement = document.getElementById('daily-photo');
            photoElement.innerHTML = `
            <div class="name-title" style="font-size: 2rem">Today's Pick</div>
            <br>
            <div class="image-container">
                <div class="pick-image">
                <a href="https://zzzhehao.github.io/gallery/gallery.html#${photo.name}">
                    <img src="${photo.url}" alt="${photo.name}">
                </a>
                </div>
            </div>
            `;
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeDailyPhoto);
</script>
```

[About {{< iconify cib:about-me >}}]{style="font-size: 2.5rem;"}

Hi! 👋 I am Zhehao. I was born and raised in Japan, lived both in Mainland China and Taiwan for some time, and I am currently studying in Hamburg. So I speak Chinese (Mandarin), Japanese, German and English 😉 feel free to write me in any of these! 

I am a M.Sc. Biology Student at University of Hamburg. I have received my B.Sc. degree with focus on molecular ecology and am now entering deep sea research with special focus on isopods. I love doing lab works but I love field works a bit more; I have interest in new technologies but I am more interested in biological process happening out there in the wild. I am trying my best to find a balance among all these.

My strengths are molecular barcoding, evolutionary, community ecology, and biogeography analysis. I started developing my taxonomic expertise around asellote isopods and the swimming Munnopsids are my favourite, despite their taxonomy and biogeography being quite difficult to desipher. 

Beside these, I'm also a heavy R coder! I write a lot of codes to automate my daily works to prevent data lost and avoidable mistakes (typos are horrible when happening to sample ID!). And I love making pretty plots, maps, and analysis that makes boring data understandable and communicable.

## {{< iconify material-symbols:fiber-new-outline >}} News of the Past Year

**2025/10** Backbone for the Peracarida! Helping organizing the workshop in Wilhelmshaven, Germany. Logistics, Instruction on CLSM, etc ... [>> Read more](https://www.peracarida.org/workshops/2025-confusing-crustaceans)

**2025/09** Trip to Iceland! Brought thousands of legacy samples from BIOICE project from Iceland to Germany, which will be used for future workshops.

**2025/08** My first professional workshop! Went back to Punta Arenas to join the Ocean Census species discovery workshop with the samples collected from February expedition!

**2025/07** My first talk on a conference! Just made *Acanthocope* known by more people on The Crustacean Society Summer Meeting in Paris!

**2025/02** My first expedition! Sailing on *R/V Falkor (too)* with Ocean Census from Punta Arenas to South Sandwich Island. [>> Read more](project/fkt250220/index.qmd)

## {{< iconify streamline:hand-held-tablet-writing >}} Posts

The intention of this website is to share my knowledge and experience with everyone. I do this because I have been helped countless times by the other's posts on the internet, and I don't want this kindness to stop with me.

## {{< iconify ph:film-reel >}} Hobbies

I take a lot of photos, simply to treasure the moments that I enjoyed and loved. I don't limit myself in certain technics or topics - I shoot both analog and digital, still and motion picture, I once tried cyanotype too, and would love to start again. I shoot wonderful nature, starlight, but also urban landscapes, people, but mostly small things in life that have made my day a bit different. 

I use photography as a way to express myself. People say the world is as one sees it. I haven't experienced excessive grief, but I've certainly seen enough. So when I create something back for the world, I want them to be something less hurting. 

You can see all my albums in my [gallery](/gallery/gallery.qmd) and some picked [motion pictures](/gallery/motion-pictures.qmd). Also check [a special folder](/gallery/blue-marble/blue-marble.qmd) for star / astro topics.
